overview: The Mega Leather, Footwear & Accessories Cluster (MLFAC) is a sub-scheme under the Indian Footwear & Leather Development Programme (IFLDP) 2021-26, implemented by the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT), Ministry of Commerce & Industry, Government of India. It aims to develop mega clusters for leather, footwear, and accessories manufacturing with infrastructure support, including industrial plots for allotment. The scheme is part of a central sector initiative with a total outlay of Rs.1700 Crores for all six sub-schemes under IFLDP during 2021-2026.
objectives: Develop mega clusters for leather, footwear, and accessories manufacturing
Provide industrial plots for allotment in identified cluster locations
Support infrastructure development in the leather and footwear sector
Promote integrated development of the leather value chain
Enhance competitiveness of Indian leather and footwear products in global markets
Facilitate technology upgradation and sustainable practices in cluster units
Generate employment and promote regional industrial development
eligibility: Eligible units must be registered with the Council for Leather Exports (CLE) or relevant authorities, possess valid Udyam Registration, and be engaged in leather, footwear, or accessories manufacturing. Applications were required to be submitted through the National Single Window System (NSWS) portal (https://www.nsws.gov.in) for consideration under the IFLDP 2021-26 scheme, subject to appraisal by PIUs (FDDI and CLRI) and final approval by the Steering Committee.
benefits: Financial assistance in the form of grants for cluster development, infrastructure support including access to industrial plots, technical guidance, and facilitation of linkages with suppliers, markets, and institutions. Benefits also include access to common facilities, skill development, and convergence with other government schemes for holistic cluster growth.
financial_support: Under the IFLDP 2021-26, the Mega Leather, Footwear and Accessories Cluster Development (MLFACD) sub-scheme is one of six components with a total allocation of Rs.1700 Crores for all sub-schemes combined during 2021-2026. Financial support is provided as grants for infrastructure development, with disbursement subject to appraisal by Project Implementation Units (PIUs) and approval by the Steering Committee. Mere submission of an application does not guarantee assistance; final approval is based on technical and financial viability.
application_process: 1. Visit the National Single Window System (NSWS) portal at https://www.nsws.gov.in 2. Register or log in to the portal 3. Select the Indian Footwear & Leather Development Programme (IFLDP) 2021-26 4. Choose the Mega Leather, Footwear and Accessories Cluster Development (MLFACD) sub-scheme 5. Fill in the application form with project details 6. Upload required documents including Udyam Registration, project report, and bank details 7. Submit the application online 8. Await appraisal by PIUs (FDDI or CLRI) 9. Receive recommendation from PIUs to the Steering Committee 10. Await final approval and grant disbursement upon clearance.
required_documents: Land documents or lease agreement for proposed site
Undertaking of compliance with scheme guidelines
deadlines: The NSWS portal for IFLDP 2021-26 was closed with immediate effect from 25th June 2025 for all sub-schemes except IDLS. For IDLS, a 15-day window was provided, closing by 10th July 2025. As of the notice dated 25th June 2025, no further applications are being accepted under MLFACD via NSWS.
implementing_agency: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT), Ministry of Commerce & Industry, Government of India
caveats: Applications are subject to appraisal by PIUs and final approval by the Steering Committee
Mere submission of an application does not entitle the applicant to government assistance

The NSWS portal for IFLDP 2021-26 is closed for all sub-schemes, except IDLS sub-scheme for Integrated Development of Leather Sector (IDLS) will be open for a 15-day window from the date of issuance of this notice i.e. by 10th July 2025 (Thursday), No further applications are being accepted under MLFACD via NSWS as of June 2025, Assistance is subject to availability of funds and scheme continuation beyond 31st March 2026
